name: presentation_external_smoke
description: Genuinely independent ArduPilot SITL instance, hand-launched with its own internal physics (ardurover --model rover, NOT the JSON/Gazebo FDM this repo's own twins use), on ports this repo does not own, with a throwaway home location (Mumbai coast) unrelated to the project's Sydney-harbor reference vehicles. Exists purely to prove tools/test_target.py works against a vehicle this repo did not build or boot -- the 'external twin' path. GPS1_TYPE=14 is baked into its own defaults file so gps_input is a fair test. connection port is from a throwaway instance -- update before reuse.
